opportunities.name: Hotel proposal email with currency conversion
opportunities.description: For a given {city} and {check_in}-{check_out} dates, search Booking.com, pick a hotel and its total EUR price, convert that price into the {recipient_currency} on xe.com, and draft an email to {recipient} proposing the hotel.
steps: On booking.com, click 'Enter destination', select all and type {city}
Open the date picker, use 'Next month' if needed, and click {check_in} then {check_out}
Click Search
Open the chosen hotel from the results and note its name and total EUR price
On xe.com's Currency Converter (EUR as the source currency), select the amount field and type the EUR price
Open the target currency dropdown, search {target_currency} and select it, then click Convert
Note the converted amount
In mail, click To and type {recipient_email}
Type Subject 'Hotel for {city}, {check_in}-{check_out}'
Type Body 'Hi {name}, proposed hotel: {hotel_name}, {eur_price} EUR (about {converted} {target_currency}). OK to book?'
Send the email (the user clicked Discard in the recording)

instances.values: Frankfurt, Nov 17-20 2026; Vienna House by Wyndham Frankfurt South, 818 EUR -> 915.34 USD; maria@example.com
Milan, Dec 1-4 2026; BB Hotels Aparthotel Visconti, 264 EUR -> 46,794 JPY; kenji@example.com
Amsterdam, Jan 12-15 2027 (Zurich was typed first at 796.5, then abandoned); Jan Luyken Amsterdam, 577 EUR -> 487.44 GBP; aisha@example.com

opportunities.name: City weather + news heads-up email
opportunities.description: For a {city} and {day}, look up the 10-day forecast on The Weather Channel, search BBC for '{city} strike' news, and draft a heads-up email to {recipient} with the forecast and the top headline.
steps: On weather.com, click the location button and the 'Search for a location' box
Type {city} and select the matching city
Click '10 Day' and read the high/low temperatures and conditions for {day}
On bbc.com, open the menu or search and type '{city} strike', then press Enter
Open the top result and note its headline and date
In mail, type To {recipient_email}
Type Subject 'Heads-up: {city} on {day}'
Type Body 'Hi {name}, {city} on {day}: {high}°/{low}°, {conditions}. Latest news: {headline} ({date}).'
Send the email (the user clicked Discard in the recording)

instances.values: Berlin, Saturday; 58°/44° Partly Cloudy; 'Students strike across Germany...'; raj@example.com
Madrid, Monday; 64°/50° Partly Cloudy; 'Villa eye Endrick loan deal'; sofia@example.com
London, Thursday; 70°/56° Cloudy; 'School support staff strike over pay'; tom@example.com

opportunities.name: Traveler visa + destination holidays note
opportunities.description: For a traveler of {nationality} going to {destination_country} in {month}, look up the visa requirement on Wikipedia, look up the destination's public holidays for that month on timeanddate.com, and save a summary note.
steps: On Wikipedia, select the search box and type 'Visa requirements for {nationality} citizens', then press Enter
Use Ctrl+F to find {destination_country} and read the visa requirement and allowed stay
On timeanddate.com, go to Holidays (dismiss the cookie dialog if it appears)
Search for or click {destination_country}, and open the full-year holiday list if needed
Note the holidays that fall in {month}
In Notes, click 'New note' and type '{nationality} traveler to {destination_country}: {visa_info}, allowed stay {stay}. Holidays in {month}: {holidays}'
Press Enter to save

instances.values: Indian -> Japan, December; eVisa; no national public holidays, Dec 31 bank holiday
Brazilian -> Canada, November; visa required (eTA possible); Nov 11 Remembrance Day
Nigerian -> United Kingdom, May; visa required; May 4 and May 25 bank holidays
